1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not chemically disrupt embryo cell membranes__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by a method comprising exposing the shed cellular material to cold followed by heat and agitation__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium __consists essentially of water and does not include alkaline solutions__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __wherein the cold, heat, and agitation steps are performed sequentially and repeated at least once__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least two times__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __wherein the heating is performed at a temperature of at least 95°C and the heating and agitation steps are repeated at least once__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least two times__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme __selected to preserve embryo viability__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME®.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __by a method that includes precipitation or magnetic particle-based purification__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to isolate DNA__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at the globular to early dent stage of development__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (a) or step (d) __in a quiescent state__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained without chemical disruption of embryo cell membranes__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the extracted DNA__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __wherein the selection is based on the genotype obtained from shed cellular material without chemical disruption of embryo cell membranes__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __to produce plants for breeding__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __including automated collection, DNA extraction, genotyping analysis, and selection__.
